rules.statement: In an action for goods sold and delivered, the defendant must prove that there was a definite period of credit and that at the end of that period the debt became payable and that the date on which the debt became payable is more than a year from the date of institution of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: In such a case the defendants must in order to succeed in their plea prove that there was a definite period of credit and that at the end of that period the debt became-payable and that the date on which the debt became payable is more than a year from the date of institution of the action.

meta.parties: Carolis Appuhamy v. Ford Footwear Ltd
